title: Cambridge IELTS 14 Academic Speaking Test 3
description: Haqiqiy IELTS/CEFR Speaking formati: Rasmiy Cambridge IELTS 14 Test 3 bo‘yicha Part 1 (Kirish va kundalik mavzular), Part 2 (Cue Card taqdimot) va Part 3 (Tahliliy munozara).

sections.title: Speaking Assessment (Parts 1-3)
sections.instructions: Ushbu bo‘lim 3 ta qismdan iborat. Har bir qism topshirig‘i bilan tanishib chiqing, tayyor bo‘lgach mikrofon tugmasini bosib ovozingizni yozing va saqlang.

questions.question_text:
Part 1: Introduction & Everyday Topics (Speak for 1-2 minutes)

1. How often do you see your neighbours? [Why/why not?]
2. Do you invite your neighbours to your home? [Why/why not?]
3. Do you think you are a good neighbour? [Why/why not?]
4. Has a neighbour ever helped you? [Why/why not?]

Part 2: Individual Long Turn / Cue Card (1 minute preparation, 2 minutes speaking)

Describe a very difficult task that you succeeded in doing as part of your work or studies.
You should say:
And explain how you felt when you had successfully completed this task.

Part 3: Two-way Discussion (Speak for 2-3 minutes)

1. What are the most difficult jobs that people do?
2. Why do you think some people choose to do difficult jobs?
3. Do you agree or disagree that all jobs are difficult sometimes?
4. How important is it for everyone to have a goal in their personal life?
5. Is it always necessary to work hard in order to achieve career success?
6. Do you think that successful people are always happy people?
